An unnamed seven-page prologue is the debut chapter of the [[Pokémon Omega Ruby Crimson Passion and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Indigo Wisdom]] manga created by 秦槙吾 Shingo Hatha. It first appeared as a sneak preview in the October 2014 issue of [[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comics]] magazine and later appeared in the collected volume release.
